name: .458 Cal-447gr Stone Hammer®
note: Recommended minimum twist rate for dangerous game hunting is 1-19″. Recommended use: Big Game and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This .458 caliber Stone Hammer™ has a 1/4″ hollow point to give the nose profile enough taper to feed reliably and deform rapidly to a minimum full caliber with 90% retained weight. The large nose dia will allow these bullets to work well in lever actions with tube magazines."
